items.title: Minor "Ram" Hall Interview, 1958-09-02
items.q: I didn't know anything about Bolden. I think when I first seen him, I was about twelve, fifteen years old.

ctx.x: No, they even told me that they thought Bolden got his idea of this whole jazz music from hearing those churches.

Well, I couldn't see, because I was too young. I didn't know anything about Bolden. I think when I first seen him, I was about twelve, fifteen years old. We kids used to walk out there, you know, just walk on over town. Because even when we started playing drums, you know, you would let us get on the street car.
